name: What should I consider when choosing a sink for a wheelchair accessible vanity?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a sink for a wheelchair accessible vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a sink for a wheelchair accessible vanity, prioritize options that allow for easy use. Shallow bowls are generally preferred as they keep the drain assembly higher, maximizing knee clearance. Off-center drains can also increase under-sink space. Ensure the faucet is easy to operate, such as lever-style or sensor-activated models. Under-mount or drop-in sinks are common, as vessel sinks can elevate the rim height too much, potentially exceeding accessibility guidelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose shallow, off-center sinks with easy-to-operate faucets to maximize knee clearance. Avoid vessel sinks as they can make the rim too high.
